purpose: Fixed local projection support prerequisite diagnostic for a possible model change; not detection improvement
cohort: All previously frozen 1417 strict small target-frames; their previously chosen min/max real40 windows, no new selection
checkpoint: Official RGB-T DeepPro-Plus, eval mode, unchanged weights
formula: q_local=sum_{abs(s-slot)<=r}W[slot,s]F[s]/sqrt(40)+bias[slot]; q_far=q_full-q_local; q_intervene=q_local+g*q_far; phi=unchanged original post-TPro backend
implementation: Keep original frontend features fixed within each original40 window. g=1 uses the same q_full for both radii. Test complement reconstruction as well as original forward replay.
crop: Original half-open bbox pixel-center crop plus16 spatial halo, no resizing, full40 real frames; no temporal halo intervention
readouts: fixed original a/b peak probability and logit
stratum_source: mechanism_followup/SUPPORT_PAIRED.csv, strong97 intersect a_suppressed_common_strong or b_requires_exclusive_strong; stable groups retain threshold0.5 definition
primary_questions: Does either fixed local radius retain high responses on originally detected/benefiting endpoints?
Does g=0.5 recover low endpoints while also destroying beneficial-context high endpoints?
Can a fixed local branch currently be treated as a reliable protective path without training?
reporting: All radii/gates/strata must be reported, including failure. No radius or gate will be changed or chosen post hoc in this probe.
limitations: GT-conditioned diagnostic crops and previously selected extreme windows
Local refers to feature time indices; frontend already has temporal radius8, so r0 is not single-frame inference
Locality is not context benefit and near/far split is not old shared/exclusive split
Potentially out-of-distribution internal ablation through pretrained BN/backend
No full-frame false alarms, original maxfusion change, training, or deployed method performance measured
No claim that failed untrained local branch rules out trained dynamic context selection
